nodes.label: AMOTIF Design System v2
nodes.rationale: Revision keeps the green-natural brand identity intact while removing patterns that read as AI-generated UI (glass everywhere, diagonal gradient on the CTA, uniform radius, generic stagger) and introduces a real signature element: the waveform.

nodes.label: Verde Natural Palette Tokens
nodes.rationale: The monochrome green scale (from --verde-pastel to --verde-tinta) is the brand identity and is deliberately preserved; --verde-tinta replaces the old --verde-escuro as the high-contrast title color.

nodes.label: Accent Latão Token
nodes.rationale: Single extra color (#8a6a14, opaque sand-gold evoking brass instruments) used only for favorites, highlights and featured badges so tone contrast exists without drifting into rainbow-SaaS.

nodes.label: Restricted Glassmorphism Scope
nodes.rationale: Glass is kept only for surfaces that float above content (navbar, modal); cards, forms, search bar, mural and collaborator list become solid white surfaces because glass applied to everything is the strongest tell of generic AI UI.

nodes.label: Three-Role Typography System
nodes.rationale: Fraunces (display) contributes organic curves matching the natural brand personality, Plus Jakarta Sans handles UI/body, and JetBrains Mono is reserved for technical audio data (BPM, delayMs, timestamps) because layer sync is measured in milliseconds. A single typeface everywhere reads as wallpaper.

nodes.label: Functional Border Radius Scale
nodes.rationale: Each element takes the radius of its functional category (buttons/inputs 8px, cards 14px, avatars full) instead of a pill default applied to everything; without radius hierarchy nothing looks deliberately decided.

nodes.label: Waveform Signature Element
nodes.rationale: The product is about audio and sync, so the visual motif was obvious but unused. The waveform replaces generic dividers as section divider, loading state, empty state and hero underline; max bar height ~24px, bar width 2-3px, gap 2px — discreet, never loose decoration.

nodes.label: Meaningful Motion Set
nodes.rationale: fadeInUp with nth-child stagger applied to every card list was removed because universal stagger is decoration, not information; motion is now reserved for real layer order (layerReveal) or identity (waveformPulse).

nodes.label: AI-Generated UI Anti-patterns
nodes.rationale: Ten explicit prohibitions (no colored left borders, no CTA gradient, no shimmer, no glass outside navbar/modal, no single radius for all, no default fadeInUp stagger, no heavy black shadows, no hypersaturated colors, no more than three typefaces, no waveform as loose decoration) exist to keep the UI from regressing to template patterns.

nodes.label: CSS File Architecture
nodes.rationale: Global.css, Navbar.css, Form.css, Login.css, Cadastro.css, Shared.css, Studio.css, User.css and Home.css keep their responsibilities unchanged; only token contents in Global.css change and glass/gradient classes are removed from Shared.css and Studio.css.
